ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Wreckage
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
SALVAGE_WRECKAGE_EVERYWHERE_1: the shared wreck engine every biome's wreckage rides on. Composed into RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes (mandrake.rm.biomes) as an engine entry; it ships no wrecks of its own.
Ships (slice 1, the loot half of design step 1): 1. RM_CompProperties_SalvageLoot / RM_CompSalvageLoot. A wreck carrying it drops an extra loot roll ONLY when it is deconstructed (DestroyMode.Deconstruct). Smashing it leaves its killedLeavings, as before. The roll comes from the ThingSetMakerDef RM_SalvageLoot_<tier>, and a rarer second roll from RM_SalvageLoot_<tier>_Rare whose chance scales with the deconstructing pawn's skill. 2. Five loot tiers (Scrap, Hull, Tank, Carapace, Sealed) as plain vanilla ThingSetMakerDefs, so the Star Wars layer can patch parts into them without touching this mod. 3. One Harmony prefix on JobDriver_Deconstruct.FinishedRemoving that notes who did the work, because ThingComp.PostDestroy is not told. 4. Mod Settings: salvage loot on/off, loot generosity, skill scaling on/off.
Not yet built (design/RimMandrake/salvage_wreckage_everywhere_design_2026-10-02.md section 7): family parents, weathering defs, the weighted wreck-field GenStep, wreck falls.
